configuration.timing_convention: at state timestamp t consume one fresh 53-unit count from [t-L-W, t-L); tile intervals from the first behavior-grid point, update every W/10 steps, and predict only between updates

normalization.state: fold-training population mean and standard deviation (ddof=0); reject a component below 1e-8
normalization.neural_counts: fold-training population mean and standard deviation (ddof=0); replace a scale below 1e-8 with 1

process_covariance_estimator.negative_eigenvalue_policy: raise below -tol; project values in [-tol, 0) to zero

covariance_recursion.measurement_update: stable low-rank information form algebraically equivalent to the Kalman update
covariance_recursion.posterior_policy: symmetrize; reject eigenvalues below the process-covariance tolerance formula; project only roundoff negatives

initialization.position: recorded once at trial start for PV/PVA; unavailable thereafter
initialization.velocity_and_acceleration: fold-training initial prior; recorded assessment values never supplied

configuration.fit_instructions: Refit every normalization, prior, transition, covariance, and observation map on all eligible training trials before one official validation run; do not reuse cross-validation parameters.
